name: hellish rebuke
lore:
# Hellish Rebuke

To the uninitiated, *Hellish Rebuke* appears as a mere reflex, but to the seasoned scholar, it is a masterpiece of retributive pyromancy. When the caster is struck, the magic manifests not as a steady flame, but as a violent, sulfurous lash of obsidian-streaked fire that erupts directly from the wound, seeking the assailant with predatory intent.

Shaping the Weave for this incantation feels like clutching a jagged, white-hot coal in the mind. It is a volatile knot of energy, held in stasis until triggered by the caster’s own agony. One does not delicately weave this spell; one unleashes it through a primal snarl of pure spite.

**The Legend of Malakor**
Archival fragments credit its discovery to Malakor the Spurned, a warlock cornered in the iron city of Dis. As a traitor’s blade pierced his ribs, Malakor did not beg for mercy. Instead, his scream of betrayal ignited the very air, reducing his murderer to a pillar of ash. He did not merely cast a spell; he weaponized his indignation, birthing a legacy of fire that punishes all who dare strike the pact-bound.
